correctness.rationale: Exact horizontal sections are nested concentric homothets at horizontal zero. A nonzero horizontal translation strictly loses overlap on a positive-height slice neighborhood. The complete scalar integral is split at axial center 1/2, and its derivative has one sign transition determined by q=2^(1/m). Analytical integration, strict monotone-likelihood-ratio ordering, and convergent exponential expansions prove the exact finite-dimensional formula, unique center, phase and dimension limit. Seven trapezoids and five square frusta independently checked with geometry clipping/quadrature; code is diagnostic, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact shape-independent core fraction classifies an infinite family of homothetic frusta for every centrally symmetric base in every dimension, including the unique optimizing center, explicit geometric transition, monotone inversion and m^-1 dimensional boundary layer. Neither the threshold nor limiting noncommutation follows from the known one-sided pyramid endpoint; the classification has natural use as a benchmark for convex-body symmetry and inverse shape measurement.
